description: Required core behavior within the live-context boundary. These are abstract conformance traces, not evidence that an actor implementation has passed them. Restart durability is not core conformance. Unless a step states otherwise, conversation traffic uses an explicitly selected applicable continuity profile with valid authorized guards and retained required context at admission; stale traffic from an ended scope is rejected at that boundary before ordinary correlation or disposition handling.

cases.name: lost acknowledgement does not repeat work in a retained context

steps.event: requester sends say S
actor accepts S in the live context
expect: ack S
exactly one semantic handling of S

steps.event: transport drops ack S
requester resends identical S
expect: ack S
no repeated semantic handling of S

cases.name: inability to accept in the live context is busy

steps.event: actor cannot accept say S in the live context
expect: refusal busy for S
no ack S
no semantic handling of S

steps.event: requester retries S after backoff
expect: same message id
busy did not consume a sending attempt

cases.name: stop overtakes an in-flight opening request within a live context

steps.event: requester sends fresh say S without in_response_to; transport delays it
requester sends stop T with turn S
actor accepts T
expect: ack T
suppression of opening request S from this asker in this conversation while the context is retained

steps.event: S arrives
expect: ack S
taken for S as not-acted-on
no work starts for S

cases.name: silence establishes no execution outcome

steps.event: requester sends say S; no response arrives
requester exhausts attempts
expect: S reported as not confirmed
no assertion that S failed or was cancelled
following submissions remain held until explicit release

cases.name: description does not require application services

steps.event: requester sends describe with only a configured actor address and compatible trust
actor answers
expect: signed description naming the request
no factory, locator, registry, or knowledge-service dependency

cases.name: memory-only acceptance is core conformant

steps.event: The actor and requester select keel.provisioned-context.v1, complete fresh provisioning for C and both receive guards, and use no durable storage
The actor admits say S while its guard and required context remain active
expect: ack S is permitted
handling and duplicate recognition apply within that protected context
no claim that acceptance survives connection loss or restart

cases.name: a missed result need not be recoverable in the core

steps.event: actor sends result R; transport loses every copy
notification attempts are exhausted
expect: R is not confirmed
actor may proceed to later notifications
no mandatory history query or replay
requester may remain unaware of completion

cases.name: state loss does not resolve an earlier outcome

steps.event: The actor accepts say S in provisioned C1 and sends ack S
The actor detects loss of its required conversation state
expect: retire its guard before further admission or replacement state
close the connection and disable old-scope conversation traffic

steps.event: The requester observes a failed connection and reconnects
expect: a new connection requires fresh provisioning and a fresh C2 under this profile
no requirement to restore or resume S
no claim that S failed or had no effects
do not automatically repeat uncertain work in C2

steps.event: An original frame signed for C1 reaches the retired guard or the C2 connection
expect: generic binding rejection: close the original associated connection with WebSocket code 1008 if still open, otherwise discard without response; no identifying close-reason details
no core disposition, new semantic handling or reservation of the presented message ID
do not create or recreate a conversation from the frame
do not admit it as fresh work even if no C1 history remains

cases.name: approval decisions are once per retained context

steps.event: approval A is pending in its originator's live context, independently of any work turn
A's originator accepts authorized decision D with matching digest before its deadline
identical D arrives again
expect: duplicate acknowledgement
no second decision

steps.event: different decision D2 for A arrives
expect: refusal closed
accepted decision D remains unchanged

cases.name: a decision cannot recreate an unknown approval

steps.event: live context has no approval A
otherwise valid decision D naming A arrives
expect: refusal unknown
no creation or reopening of A
no authority inferred from the decision alone

cases.name: actor policy may release progress before notification attempts exhaust

steps.event: The conversation actor has sent progress P in its ordinary slot and has terminal result R ready; P has no confirmed acceptance or terminal refusal and its attempt limit has not been reached
Actor infrastructure ends P's local attempts under its own policy
expect: release P's sending slot
P remains not confirmed
do not infer non-delivery, withdrawal, or reversal of its reported actor transition

steps.event: The actor sends R in the available ordinary slot
expect: R uses its own exact signed bytes and delivery state
no second concurrent ordinary slot is introduced
no eventual delivery guarantee for P or R follows

cases.name: repeated busy does not prevent policy release of a notification slot

steps.event: Actor progress P occupies the ordinary notification slot; the receiver repeatedly returns valid busy refusals and no acceptance is established
Busy is handled while retrying P
expect: wait for backoff without consuming an attempt
do not treat busy as acknowledgement, acceptance, or terminal refusal

steps.event: Actor infrastructure explicitly ends P's local attempts and releases its slot despite the attempt budget remaining
expect: P stays not confirmed
the actor may proceed to its ready result R
no required priority scheduler or mandatory release time

steps.event: After valid R is accepted for known S, a delayed first copy of still-valid P for S arrives
expect: ack P as a consistent historical fact under P06
do not reopen S
the sender's earlier release did not retract P

cases.name: resuming a released notification preserves its bytes slot and continuity

steps.event: The actor retained exact signed P after policy release; P is unconfirmed and newer R currently holds the ordinary sending slot
Infrastructure elects to attempt P again within independently established context continuity
expect: use the exact original compact JWS and message ID
wait for the ordinary slot rather than sending in an additional slot
do not rewrite P under a renewed credential

steps.event: After R's slot is released, the original P is sent
expect: ordinary current admission or eligible retained-copy rules govern receipt
do not infer prior receiver acceptance merely from local retention or resumption

cases.name: a fresh connection alone cannot resume a released notification safely

steps.event: Under keel.provisioned-context.v1 the actor retains unconfirmed P from C1, but its connection fails and its guard retires
A new connection becomes reachable
expect: fresh provisioning with a different C2 is required
do not automatically replay P or rewrite its signed C1 to C2
preserve uncertainty about any earlier copy and effects

steps.event: Original P signed for C1 is nevertheless delivered on active C2
expect: generic binding rejection: close the original associated connection with WebSocket code 1008 if still open, otherwise discard without response; no identifying close-reason details
no core disposition, new semantic handling or reservation of the presented message ID
do not create or recreate a conversation from the frame
local release of P's sending slot supplies no continuity evidence

cases.name: actor notification release policy does not transfer requester release authority

steps.event: Principal actor A is the requester in a conversation owned by actor B; A's submission S is unconfirmed and holds A's ordinary slot
S exhausts its attempts
expect: later submissions remain held until the requester's applicable explicit release or confirmation/refusal
the actor prefix in A's name does not make it the conversation actor
B's notification-release policy is not authority to release A's submission

cases.name: ending delivery attempts does not withdraw an independent approval

steps.event: The conversation actor originated pending approval P and sent it; P's delivery is unconfirmed and its deadline has not passed
Actor infrastructure ends local delivery attempts and releases P's ordinary sending slot
expect: P remains pending under its owner and deadline
no acceptance, decision, expiry, or withdrawal is inferred from delivery release
ordinary owner and deadline duties still apply

cases.name: a valid result confirms its opening without a separate ack

steps.event: Requester opening S holds the ordinary sending slot; ack S and taken S are lost; unrelated submission N waits in the queue
Valid result R for retained eligible opening S passes complete current admission
expect: accept R and ack R
confirm acceptance of S and stop S retries
release only S's slot so N may proceed under ordinary rules
retain R as the actual evidence; do not fabricate a received ack S

cases.name: a valid question confirms its known opening before taken

steps.event: Retained eligible opening S is unconfirmed in its sending slot; no taken S has arrived
Valid question Q for S passes full admission
expect: accept Q and ack Q
confirm S and release any slot held by S
Q establishes S opened without proving it is still active now
do not manufacture an ack S

cases.name: valid progress confirms its known opening before taken

steps.event: Retained eligible opening S is unconfirmed in its sending slot; no taken S has arrived
Valid progress P for S passes full admission
expect: accept P and ack P
confirm S and release any slot held by S
do not confirm unrelated contributions, answers, or stops
do not manufacture an ack S

cases.name: not-acted-on confirms handling of only its identified say

steps.event: The requester has retained contribution C naming S; C is unconfirmed and holds the ordinary slot; no report has established S opened
Consistent taken T names C as not-acted-on without turn and passes full admission
expect: ack T
confirm handling of C, stop its retries, and release C's slot
do not infer C was admitted or S opened
do not confirm S solely from C's rejected contribution disposition

cases.name: positive contribution admission confirms the input and opening only

steps.event: Opening S was explicitly released while unconfirmed; retained contribution C naming S now holds the ordinary slot and stop K naming S holds the permitted additional slot
Valid taken T admits C as added-to-turn with turn S
expect: ack T
confirm C and S from their specific admission evidence
stop C retries and release C's slot
K remains unconfirmed in its own slot
do not fabricate received acknowledgements for C or S

cases.name: positive answer admission confirms the answer and opening only

steps.event: The requester retains S, Q for S, and issued answer A naming Q; A is unconfirmed in the ordinary slot and stop K for S is unconfirmed in the additional slot
Valid taken T admits A as answer with question Q and turn S
expect: ack T
confirm A and S; release any sending slots still held by those messages
retain Q's answered disposition
K remains unconfirmed
do not equate the received T with received ack frames

cases.name: a result does not confirm contributions answers or a named stop

steps.event: The requester retains S, earlier unconfirmed answer A whose slot was explicitly released, contribution C currently in flight, and stop K beside C targeting S
Valid result R naming S with status stopped passes full admission
expect: ack R and retain S's terminal result
confirm S only if not already confirmed
do not confirm A, C, or K from the result status or their relation to S
C and K retain their independent unconfirmed sending slots
later ordinary submissions remain held until those slots are independently settled or explicitly released

cases.name: answered closure does not confirm even the only locally known answer

steps.event: The requester retains Q and issued answer A naming Q; A holds an unconfirmed sending slot and no other candidate answer is locally known
Valid owner closed C names Q with why answered
expect: ack C and establish Q's authoritative closure reason
do not identify A as the admitted answer or confirm A
A's slot remains held until specific confirmation, terminal refusal, or explicit release
absence of another locally known answer is not proof that none exists

cases.name: decided closure does not confirm a particular decision

steps.event: Independent approval P is known; the requester has issued decision D naming P and D remains unconfirmed
Valid owner closed C names P with why decided
expect: ack C and retain P's terminal reason
do not confirm D or release its sending slot from this closure alone
do not infer the decision contents from closed P

cases.name: an invalid semantic report cannot confirm the input it names

steps.event: The requester retains opening S and contribution C targeting S; C is unconfirmed in its sending slot
Authenticated structurally valid taken T names C but claims as new-turn with turn C
expect: refusal malformed for T after complete semantic checking
do not confirm C before discovering its inconsistent role
C's slot remains held

steps.event: Isolated semantic-validation specimen only: authenticated report T2 naming C is supplied directly to the semantic checker with a different actor signer lacking authority in this context; the earlier admission guard is intentionally not executed in this specimen
expect: the isolated semantic check identifies not-authorized for T2
do not confirm C or change its sending slot
a full receiver rejects the foreign signer at its earlier profile/scope guard; this specimen does not require sending a core refusal after that rejection

cases.name: late confirmation of a released input cannot release a newer slot

steps.event: The requester explicitly released unconfirmed opening S; newer opening N now holds the ordinary slot
Valid result R for eligible S arrives
expect: ack R and confirm S
update S's established disposition without releasing N's slot
N remains subject to its own confirmation, refusal, or explicit release

cases.name: acknowledgement correlation is scoped rather than an ID-only lookup

steps.event: Requester submission S with UUID X is unconfirmed in conversation C; the receiver knows no corresponding outgoing X in conversation D
An authenticated actor ack names X and is correctly addressed to independently established active conversation D on D's own authorized guard, where no outgoing X is known
expect: do not confirm S in C
do not release C's sending slot
do not respond to the control acknowledgement

steps.event: A valid ack naming X arrives from S's intended receiver in C
expect: confirm S and release its slot
retain the actual ack as evidence
send no acknowledgement of that ack

cases.name: a closed question admitted without its parent confirms no absent opening

steps.event: The receiver retains an authorized owner closure marker for unseen Q, but no live opening S
Q arrives naming S and qualifies for the closed-question exception
expect: ack Q and retain its already-closed status
do not create or confirm S
do not manufacture a received ack or a sending slot for S
the ordinary eligible-opening confirmation rule is not triggered

cases.name: causal references and evidence attachments do not confirm their subjects

steps.event: The requester retains eligible S and separate unconfirmed request C in another conversation; a valid progress notification P for S carries caused_by and evidence references to C
P passes full admission
expect: ack P and confirm only S under P's report kind
do not confirm C, release its slot, or infer its admission from attribution or attached evidence

cases.name: a validated description confirms its retained describe request

steps.event: The requester has a retained non-conversation describe D addressed to actor B and has received no separate ack D
B's valid description names D and passes current authentication, addressing, structure, and semantic correlation checks
expect: confirm D and stop its retries
retain the actual description as acceptance evidence
do not fabricate a received ack D

steps.event: Another currently authenticated actor C sends a description naming D through an independently assured actor-level route, but lacks authority to answer the request addressed to B
expect: refusal not-authorized for that description
do not use it as confirmation of D or another outstanding describe

cases.name: a description in the wrong scope cannot settle another request

steps.event: The requester retains non-conversation describe D to B; a separate outgoing message S to B in active conversation C happens to have the same UUID under its distinct request scope
Valid non-conversation description from B names D
expect: confirm only D
do not release S's conversation sending slot because its UUID matches

steps.event: A fresh authenticated description from B naming D incorrectly includes to.conversation C; its sender, recipient and C match the active guard, but the description payload schema forbids that field
expect: refusal malformed for that description
do not confirm D or S from the refused response
